name: e2e-test
description: Sets up Playwright E2E tests with istanbul branch coverage and generates, runs and fixes a test for each code branch

interface.shortDescription: Set up Playwright E2E tests and cover every code branch
interface.longDescription: Sets up Playwright E2E testing for a frontend project, with istanbul branch coverage and the Playwright MCP, then analyses each branch in the code to generate, run and fix test cases. Scope a run to one route, one file or only the uncovered branches.
defaultPrompt: Set up Playwright E2E tests for this project.
Write E2E tests for the uncovered branches.
